description: This file defines the SectionComponent class in the Drupal layout_builder module, representing a layout section component with properties, methods for rendering, configuration, and plugin management.

classes.name: SectionComponent
classes.description: Represents a layout section component with properties like UUID, region, configuration, weight, and methods for rendering, configuration management, and plugin handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SectionComponent with UUID, region, configuration, and additional properties.

methods.name: toRenderArray
methods.description: Generates a renderable array for the component, dispatching an event and applying cache metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an arbitrary property or additional data by property name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets an arbitrary property or additional data by property name.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region of the component.

methods.name: setRegion
methods.description: Sets the region of the component.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the component.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the component.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin ID from configuration, throws exception if missing.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the component.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Creates and returns the plugin instance, applying contexts if provided.

methods.name: pluginManager
methods.description: Returns the plugin manager service for blocks.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the component to an array for custom storage.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a SectionComponent object from an array representation.
